data.title: 初雪 · 浪涌浅滩旁捧起冰镇圣果的纯真浅笑
data.action: 双手捧着一颗破开的青椰冰饮，侧身坐在平滑的白沙滩上，巨大蓬松的雪豹尾巴环在膝前防沙，娇羞仰望
data.location: 远离严寒与神圣神殿的南方热带海岛私密白沙浅滩
data.lighting: 上午纯澈透亮的阳光穿透椰林枝叶，在银白长发与毛茸茸的雪豹长尾上泛起银粉般的晶莹高光
data.mood: 卸下圣女重担的少女天真、纯净羞怯与难得的自由安宁
data.description: 终于不用终日端坐在冰冷的神殿圣座之上。初雪将厚重祭袍换成轻灵飘逸的雪白泳裙，蓬松丰满的雪豹大尾巴环绕在身前，小心翼翼地护着自己不沾沙粒。她双手捧着插着吸管的冰镇青椰递到你面前，雪白双耳微微耷拉着羞红了耳尖——「在谢拉格……从不曾见过这样广阔温热的大海。初雪……暂时不是耶拉冈德的巫女，只是恩雅。这个甜甜的椰子，先请博士尝第一口吧。」
data.promptProse: Pramanix sits sideways on powdery white sand at a quiet tropical cove, wearing a snow-white and pale cyan swimdress with delicate frostwork lace, soft neckline fur trim, and small silver waist bells. Her plush snow leopard tail curls neatly around her legs as she holds out a fresh coconut with a straw and looks up with a shy, sunlit smile.
data.animaCaption: Seated sideways on clean white sand with her fluffy tail curled protectively around her knees, she offers a chilled green coconut with both hands and looks up with a shy blush in her white-and-cyan swimdress. Clear morning sunlight filters through palm fronds over the quiet cove.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a snow-white and pale icy-cyan swimdress with soft white fur trim along the sweetheart neckline, frost-pattern lace, and tiny silver bells at the waist.
